text: Complainant states his daughter Pooja Sahu left home on 18 September for a job interview in Pandri.
She responded to an online hospitality vacancy advertisement promising boarding in Raipur.
Witnesses observed a white SUV vehicle CG-04-RP-9921 departing near Tatibandh junction late evening.
The phone was abruptly switched off past the toll boundary.
Second victim Sarita Markam reported missing under identical circumstances from Telibandha.
Suspect Ramesh Tiwari alias Bhura was seen coordinating movements near hotel transit desk.
Frequent financial transfers noted via UPI to centralized account.
Investigation instituted under section 365 IPC at Kotwali Raipur.
